messages.text: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
EVM means Error Vector Magnitude, and in 5G NR test context it is the measured difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [2].  
For base-station modulation quality, EVM is the difference between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, where that difference is called the error vector [10].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on EVM
| Decision area | What the EVM understanding controls | Product / test context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE FR1 SA pre-conformance setup | The EVM PUCCH/PUSCH test case requires choosing the Test ID, RB allocation, modulation scheme, max-power and min-power measurement points, and verifying that DUT EVM is within the specified range [1]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1 on CMX workflow [1]. | [1] |
| UE FR1 EVM limit selection | The applicable average EVM limit depends on modulation, with listed limits for Pi/2-BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM, plus test tolerance rules [3]. | 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance EVM limits [3]. | [3] |
| UE min-power / 256QAM planning | Minimum-power interpretation matters because 256QAM Test IDs use target power Pmin + 10 dB, and Pmin depends on channel bandwidth [55]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 minimum-power context summarized in EVM page [55]. | [55] |
| CMX500 NR FR1 uplink TX option planning | R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC measurement [24]. | R&S CMX500 NR FR1 measurements [24]. | [24] |
| CMX500 SRS measurement planning | CMX500 SRS RF measurements include TX power and EVM, and support SRS antenna switching and carrier switching scenarios [4]. | R&S CMX500 SRS RF measurements [4]. | [4] |
| SRS carrier-switching option check | R&S CMX-KS610B is stated for SRS carrier switching, but the passages do not list the full order number or confirm whether R&S CMX-KM600, R&S CMX-KM604, receiver-chain hardware, or other measurement options are also needed [5]. | CMX500 SRS option traceability [5]. | [5] |
| Conducted base-station transmitter test mode | For conducted BS testing, EVM is used for modulation quality test case 6.5.3, and 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Error/Power measurements [10][11]. | R&S FSW 5G NR base-station Tx testing [10][11]. | [10][11] |
| Conducted base-station analyzer / option choice | Modulation quality test case 6.5.3 requires FSW Base Unit and FSW K144 in the listed setup [12]. | R&S FSW conducted BS Tx test setup [12]. | [12] |
| OTA base-station metric selection | OTA modulation quality is classified as EVM and directional [31]. | 5G NR OTA base-station transmitter tests [31]. | [31] |
| OTA calibration planning | OTA transmitter test systems must be calibrated before testing, and the listed calibration uses SMW-K544 and FSW-K544 to account for cable, antenna, and OTA losses [32]. | 5G NR OTA base-station transmitter tests [32]. | [32] |
| FR2 OTA beam-direction choice | A non-power measurement such as EVM can use the TX beam peak direction [19]. | FR2 OTA spatial test metrics [19]. | [19] |
| FR2 OTA EVM metric mapping | The FR2 OTA metric overview lists 6.4.2.2 EVM at TX-BP [81]. | FR2 OTA spatial test metrics [81]. | [81] |
| CMP200 NR FR2 result and setting choice | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation modulation results include EVM traces and single values, and its settings include repetition, measured subframes, measure slot, trigger settings, statistic count, and UE power class [25]. | R&S CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation [25]. | [25] |
| CMP200 specification-risk check | The CMP200 source is a Features and Functions document, not a specifications datasheet, so measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be checked in the specifications document [26]. | R&S CMP200 documentation limits [26]. | [26] |
| Signal-generator performance check | R&S SMCV100B passages list EVM-related performance for 3GPP FDD with R&S SMCVB-K242 and custom digital modulation with R&S SMCVB-K199 [48]. | R&S SMCV100B signal performance [48]. | [48] |
| High-end analyzer / component characterization choice | R&S FSWX is described as usable for modulation-quality EVM cross-correlation and for characterizing components with stringent EVM requirements [49]. | R&S FSWX product positioning [49]. | [49] |
| Small-cell production-demo caution | The small-cell WMT production demo lists EVM among TX test items and also states the demo is “1 BY 4 WITH PVT360A” with TX measurement by RF cable [16][18]. | Small Cell WMT production demo [16][18]. | [16][18] |
| PVT360A specification caution | The same demo source is not a PVT360A datasheet, configuration guide, or features document, so it cannot be used to infer PVT360A RF, bandwidth, option, DUT-count, RF-path, connector, or 10 MHz reference specifications [17]. | Small Cell WMT production demo limits [17]. | [17] |
### Limits of the answer
The passages do not provide a complete EVM measurement tutorial or complete 3GPP TS 38.521-1 text [52].  
The passages warn not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the EVM page [52].  
Formal pass/fail limits must be checked against the relevant standard, instrument document, software version, and test condition [52].

### Short answer
EVM means Error Vector Magnitude, and in 5G NR test context it is the measured difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [2].  
For base-station modulation quality, EVM is the difference between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, where that difference is called the error vector [10].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on EVM
| Decision area | What the EVM understanding controls | Product / test context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE FR1 SA pre-conformance setup | The EVM PUCCH/PUSCH test case requires choosing the Test ID, RB allocation, modulation scheme, max-power and min-power measurement points, and verifying that DUT EVM is within the specified range [1]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1 on CMX workflow [1]. | [1] |
| UE FR1 EVM limit selection | The applicable average EVM limit depends on modulation, with listed limits for Pi/2-BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM, plus test tolerance rules [3]. | 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance EVM limits [3]. | [3] |
| UE min-power / 256QAM planning | Minimum-power interpretation matters because 256QAM Test IDs use target power Pmin + 10 dB, and Pmin depends on channel bandwidth [55]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 minimum-power context summarized in EVM page [55]. | [55] |
| CMX500 NR FR1 uplink TX option planning | R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC measurement [24]. | R&S CMX500 NR FR1 measurements [24]. | [24] |
| CMX500 SRS measurement planning | CMX500 SRS RF measurements include TX power and EVM, and support SRS antenna switching and carrier switching scenarios [4]. | R&S CMX500 SRS RF measurements [4]. | [4] |
| SRS carrier-switching option check | R&S CMX-KS610B is stated for SRS carrier switching, but the passages do not list the full order number or confirm whether R&S CMX-KM600, R&S CMX-KM604, receiver-chain hardware, or other measurement options are also needed [5]. | CMX500 SRS option traceability [5]. | [5] |
| Conducted base-station transmitter test mode | For conducted BS testing, EVM is used for modulation quality test case 6.5.3, and 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Error/Power measurements [10][11]. | R&S FSW 5G NR base-station Tx testing [10][11]. | [10][11] |
| Conducted base-station analyzer / option choice | Modulation quality test case 6.5.3 requires FSW Base Unit and FSW K144 in the listed setup [12]. | R&S FSW conducted BS Tx test setup [12]. | [12] |
| OTA base-station metric selection | OTA modulation quality is classified as EVM and directional [31]. | 5G NR OTA base-station transmitter tests [31]. | [31] |
| OTA calibration planning | OTA transmitter test systems must be calibrated before testing, and the listed calibration uses SMW-K544 and FSW-K544 to account for cable, antenna, and OTA losses [32]. | 5G NR OTA base-station transmitter tests [32]. | [32] |
| FR2 OTA beam-direction choice | A non-power measurement such as EVM can use the TX beam peak direction [19]. | FR2 OTA spatial test metrics [19]. | [19] |
| FR2 OTA EVM metric mapping | The FR2 OTA metric overview lists 6.4.2.2 EVM at TX-BP [81]. | FR2 OTA spatial test metrics [81]. | [81] |
| CMP200 NR FR2 result and setting choice | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation modulation results include EVM traces and single values, and its settings include repetition, measured subframes, measure slot, trigger settings, statistic count, and UE power class [25]. | R&S CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation [25]. | [25] |
| CMP200 specification-risk check | The CMP200 source is a Features and Functions document, not a specifications datasheet, so measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be checked in the specifications document [26]. | R&S CMP200 documentation limits [26]. | [26] |
| Signal-generator performance check | R&S SMCV100B passages list EVM-related performance for 3GPP FDD with R&S SMCVB-K242 and custom digital modulation with R&S SMCVB-K199 [48]. | R&S SMCV100B signal performance [48]. | [48] |
| High-end analyzer / component characterization choice | R&S FSWX is described as usable for modulation-quality EVM cross-correlation and for characterizing components with stringent EVM requirements [49]. | R&S FSWX product positioning [49]. | [49] |
| Small-cell production-demo caution | The small-cell WMT production demo lists EVM among TX test items and also states the demo is “1 BY 4 WITH PVT360A” with TX measurement by RF cable [16][18]. | Small Cell WMT production demo [16][18]. | [16][18] |
| PVT360A specification caution | The same demo source is not a PVT360A datasheet, configuration guide, or features document, so it cannot be used to infer PVT360A RF, bandwidth, option, DUT-count, RF-path, connector, or 10 MHz reference specifications [17]. | Small Cell WMT production demo limits [17]. | [17] |
### Limits of the answer
The passages do not provide a complete EVM measurement tutorial or complete 3GPP TS 38.521-1 text [52].  
The passages warn not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the EVM page [52].  
Formal pass/fail limits must be checked against the relevant standard, instrument document, software version, and test condition [52].

answer.question: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

passages.text:
EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements
[[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] RF measurement use case：針對 5G NR [[SRS]] modes / configurations 執行 TX power、[[EVM]] 等量測，並支援 [[SRS antenna switching]] / carrier switching 場景；[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 進一步補充 SRS antenna switching 的 xTyR 技術背景與 receiver-side [[Receiver Pre-adder]] / selection 概念。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › Option 線索
來源明示：

- [[R&S CMX-KS610B]] NR SIG EXT. FSET3 – for SRS carrier switching（來自 [[CMX500_Callbox]]）。

來源未列出 [[R&S CMX-KS610B]] 的完整 order number，也未列出是否需要 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]、[[R&S CMX-KM604]]、receiver-chain hardware options 或其他 measurement options；需回正式 CMX500 features / configuration guide。

[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 雖提到 receiver side “on CMX”，但未標示完整 CMX 型號、software release、option stack 或 UI / automation 設定方式；不可據此推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 所有版本均支援所有 receiver pre-adder / selection 場景。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › Receiver pre-adder / selection
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，receiver side（來源文字：on CMX）不一定需要讓所有 received streams 都進入獨立 receiver chains；部分 received streams 可在進入 receiver chains 前先被 selected 或 added。這在 receiver chains 數量有限，或使用者希望只使用有限 receiver chains 時有用。

來源的 general configuration 描述：

- UE 端：logical ports mapping 到 UE 的 physical antenna ports；來源示例為 two logical ports mapped to two out of four physical antennas。
- Receiver 端：receive streams 0 & 2 以及 receive streams 1 & 3 可先相加，再送入 receiver chains。
- 對四個 receive streams，來源允許使用 1、2 或 4 條 receiver chains。
- 若使用 4 條 receiver chains，所有 received streams 直接 mapping 到 receiver chains，不做 selection 或 addition。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.3 Modulation quality
- 定義為 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。
- 可用 EVM 表示。
- EVM 是 equalization 後 ideal symbols 與 measured symbols 的差異讀值，該差異稱為 error vector。

EVM requirements：

- QPSK：18.5%。
- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。

Frequency error 與 EVM SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:FERRor[:AVERage]?`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Manual operation 共通流程
來源說多數測試共用相同初始步驟：

- 執行任何測試前，建議按下儀器前面板 PRESET 鍵，將儀器 reset 至 default state。
- 某些量測需透過 external reference 將 FSW 同步至 high precision time reference。
- 使用 external reference 時，需將 external reference signal 接至後面板 reference input，並將 reference frequency input 改為 External Reference。
- FSW 前面板可透過 SETUP key → sidebar 選 Reference → popup list 選 External Reference：10 MHz、1…50 MHz、100 MHz、1 GHz。

單次量測控制位於 front panel Function Keys：

- RUN SINGLE：開始新的 single-shot measurement，量測後停止 acquisition。
- RUN CONT：開始 continuous / repetitive measurements。

不同 BS transmitter tests 需要不同 operation mode：

- Spectrum mode。
- 5G NR mode。

Spectrum mode 量測用途：

- Occupied bandwidth（OBW）：對應 6.6.2。
- Transmitter spurious emissions：對應 6.6.5。

5G NR mode 量測用途：

- EVM/Frequency Err/Power：用於 Base station output power（6.2）、Frequency error（6.5.2）、Modulation quality（6.5.3）。
- Time Alignment Error：用於 TAE（6.5.4）。
- Transmit ON/OFF Power：用於 Transmit on/off power（6.4）。
- Channel Power ACLR：用於 ACLR（6.6.3）。
- SEM：用於 OBUE（6.6.4）。

FSW 5G NR signal analysis overview-screen 可設定：Deployment、Channel bandwidth、Test model、Center-frequency、Reference level、FSW attenuation。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Test setup 與必要 options
完整 Tx test setup 使用 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 執行量測；完整 Tx test setup 使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 作為 interferer。部分測試需要修改 setup，於各測試章節個別說明。

WIC Glossary › RF、電氣與調變
- [[4-PSK]] — See [[QPSK]]。
- [[8-PSK]] — Higher-order [[PSK]] digital modulation。
- [[50Ω]] — RF termination attenuator with 50 Ω wave impedance to prevent unwanted reflections for better [[VSWR]]。
- [[AC]] — Alternating Current，並指向 [[DC]]。
- [[DC]] — Direct Current，並指向 [[AC]]。
- [[BB]] — Base Band；wanted signal 的 frequency range with a dedicated [[BW]]。
- [[BW]] — Band Width。
- [[BNC]] — Bayonet Neill-Concelman connector。
- [[CATR]] — Compact Antenna Test Range。
- [[CW]] — Continuous Wave/Waveform；constant amplitude and frequency 的 electromagnetic wave。
- [[EVM]] — Error Vector Magnitude。
- [[EMC]] — ElectroMagnetic Compatibility。

WIC Glossary › 協定、網路與通訊角色
- [[ACK]] — Acknowledged。
- [[AMR]] — Adaptive Multi-Rate；set of audio codecs with patented audio data compression scheme optimized for speech coding。
- [[ARFCN]] — Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number；specifies a pair of [[UL]] + [[DL]] physical radio carriers and channels。
- [[ARQ]] — Automatic Repeat Request。
- [[ASCU]] — Advanced Signal Conditioning Unit；SCU with RF filters and amplifiers。
- [[BCCH]] — BroadCast Control Channel。
- [[BLER]] — Block Error Rate。
- [[BS]] — [[Base Station]]，counterpart of [[MS]]。
- [[BTS]] — Base Transceiver Station。
- [[BU]] — Bad Urban fading profile。
- [[CC]] — Call Control。
- [[CDMA]] — Code Division Multiplex Access；channel access method allowing several transmitters over one physical channel。
- [[CDMA2000]] — CDMA2000 family of standards describes use of CDMA technology。
- [[Compass]] — Chinese [[GNSS]]。
- [[CQI]] — Channel Quality Indicator。
- [[CS]] — Circuit Switched，counterpart of [[PS]]，例如 classical [[GSM]]。
- [[CSD]] — Circuit Switched Data，counterpart of [[GPRS]]，例如 classical [[GSM]]。
- [[DCH]] — Dedicated Channel。
- [[DCI]] — Downlink Control Information。
- dedicated network connection — direct network connection between the test instrument and a PC；Windows may use [[APIPA]] to find IP configuration automatically。
- [[DGPS]] — Differential-GPS with an enhancement from a difference signal to increase accuracy。
- [[DL]] — Downlink，signal direction from base to mobile station，counterpart of [[UL]]。
- [[DRB]] — Data Radio Bearer。
- [[DSP]] — Digital Signal Processor；processor for manipulating digital signals。
- [[DTX]] — Discontinuous Transmission。
- [[DUT]] — Device Under Test；technology-independent name for a device tested with special instruments or test systems，例如 [[MS]]、[[BS]]、[[UE]]。
- [[E-DCH]] — Enhanced uplink DCH。

WIC Glossary › 概念

- [[CMW subnet]] — 使用獨立且一致 IP address scheme 的 test equipment communications network。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP @ Beam Peak / TX Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

因此在此來源中：

- Power measurement at strongest TX beam 可用 [[EIRP]] @ beam peak。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › TRP @ Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- TRP metric – two antennas required, link + measurement。
- Lock the beam in best TX beam。
- Measure power per grid point。
- Calculate average。

判斷：本來源將 [[TRP]] @ beam peak 描述為固定最佳 TX beam 後，在 sphere grid 上量測 power 並平均；此處是 FR2 UE conformance presentation 的簡化說明，正式 grid / uncertainty / integration method 仍需回查 3GPP 或 application note。

CMP200 Features and Functions Version 09 › NR FR2 measurement results 與 settings
NR FR2 multi-evaluation modulation results 包含 EVM traces and single values、magnitude error、phase error、I/Q constellation diagram、in-band emissions、equalizer spectrum flatness、I/Q origin offset、I/Q gain imbalance、I/Q quadrature error、carrier frequency error、transmit time error、sample clock error、total TX power、TX power per RX antenna、peak power、RB power。

NR FR2 spectrum results 包含 spectrum emission mask、ACLR、occupied bandwidth（OBW）。CA 時 spectrum results 針對 aggregated bandwidth 測量；two RX antennas 時針對 two antenna signals 的 sum 測量。

NR FR2 power results 包含 power monitor trace、power dynamics trace、on power RMS and peak、off power before / after on power。

NR FR2 multi-evaluation measurement settings 抄錄：

- Repetition：single shot 或 continuous measurement。
- Measured subframes per radio frame：**1 subframe to 10 subframes**。
- Subframes for power monitor：**1 subframe to 100 subframes**。
- Measure slot：all，或 **0 to 79**。
- Trigger source：free run（fast sync / no sync）、IF power、external signal at rear panel、trigger signal provided by other application。
- Trigger threshold：**-50 dB to 0 dB**。
- Trigger delay：**-250 µs to 250 µs**。
- Trigger timeout：off，或 **10 ms to 167772150 ms**。
- Minimum trigger gap：**0 µs to 1000 µs**。
- Statistic count：**1 slot to 1000 slots**。
- TX DC location offset：**-2048 subcarriers to 2047 subcarriers**。
- UE power class：**1 to 4**。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › 涵蓋測項
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021），[[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 測項如下：

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |
| 6.3.2 | RE power control dynamic range | RE power 與 average RE power 差值；來源說由 EVM test 提供足夠 coverage。 |
| 6.3.3 | Total power dynamic range | OFDM symbol maximum transmit power 與 minimum transmit power 差值。 |
| 6.3.4 | NB-IoT RB power dynamic range | NB-IoT power boosting；與 OBUE / SEM 一起測試。 |
| 6.4 | Transmit ON/OFF power | TDD operation 的 transmitter OFF period mean power。 |
| 6.5.2 | Frequency error | actual NR BS transmit frequency 與 assigned frequency 的差值。 |
| 6.5.3 | Modulation quality | 以 EVM 表示 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。 |
| 6.5.4 | Time alignment error（TAE） | 多個 NR signals 之間最大 timing difference。 |
| 6.6.2 | Occupied bandwidth（OBW） | 99% power bandwidth；測得 OBW 應小於 nominal bandwidth。 |
| 6.6.3 | Adjacent channel leakage power ratio（ACLR） | assigned channel power 與 adjacent channel power 的 filtered mean power ratio。 |
| 6.6.4 | Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM） | Operating band unwanted emissions / spectrum emission mask。 |
| 6.6.5 | Transmitter spurious emissions | 9 kHz 至 12.75 GHz 及部分 band 5th harmonic 上限的 spurious emission 測試。 |
| 6.7 | Transmitter intermodulation | 需額外 interferer，評估 transmitter 抑制 intermodulation products 的能力。 |

3GPP TS 38.141-2 › OTA uncertainty 與 calibration
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06）：

- Maximum acceptable uncertainty is specified for each radiated test（Chapter 4.1.2）。
- Test requirement combines MU and minimum requirement。
- 來源範例為 BS type 2-O normal conditions 的 OTA base station output power。
- Additional uncertainty contributors 摘錄自 [[3GPP TR 37.843]]，包含 probe position、probe pattern knowledge、measurement distance、multiple reflections、receiver chain mismatch、probe antenna absolute gain、measurement repeatability / positioning repeatability。
- OTA measurement chamber specific calibration procedures captured in [[3GPP TR 37.843]]。
- FR2 calibration procedures in some areas are for further study（FFS）。

依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- OTA system 必須在測試前校準。
- Calibration 使用 SMW-K544 與 FSW-K544 user defined frequency response correction options。
- System loss 包含 cable losses、antenna losses、OTA losses 等。
- Calibration 流程包含 sweep CW signal、measure received power、create attenuation table、apply attenuation table and reference antenna gain table to K544。

3GPP TS 38.521-1 › 在 1C111 中支撐的測試類別
[[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 摘要多個 selected test cases，包括：

- UE maximum output power、MPR、A-MPR、configured transmitter power、minimum output power。
- General ON/OFF time mask。
- Absolute / relative / aggregate power tolerance。
- Frequency error。
- [[EVM]] PUCCH/PUSCH、carrier leakage、in-band emissions、EVM equalizer spectrum flatness。
- Occupied bandwidth、spectrum emission mask、additional spectrum emission mask、NR ACLR、UTRA ACLR。
- Reference sensitivity power level、maximum input level。

3GPP TS 38.521-1 › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準原文摘要；目前只記錄 [[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對該標準的引用方式。

- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 明示其 procedures 可能經過 streamlined 或 simplified，且不嚴格遵循所有 parameters；不可把 application note 等同完整 conformance requirement。

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S SMCV100B › I/Q modulation
- Operating mode：internal baseband I/Q。
- RF modulation bandwidth 最大 signal bandwidth 取決於 baseband option configuration：`8 kHz < f ≤ 240 MHz` 為 `±50% of carrier frequency`；`f > 240 MHz` 為 `±120 MHz`。
- RF frequency response：standard up to `120 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 3.5 dB`、`< 2.5 dB measured`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K547`、optimization mode high quality、up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 1.2 dB`、`< 0.3 dB measured`。
- Carrier leakage：mode internal baseband I/Q，referenced to full-scale input，`< –60 dBc`、`< –80 dBc measured`。
- Image sideband suppression：entire instrument in modulation bandwidth，up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth`，`> 80 dB measured`，圖中少數頻率除外。
- Modulation error ratio：`> 40 dB measured`；測量條件為 single carrier waveform signal、`8 Msample/s`、root raised cosine rolloff、`α = 0.20`、`64QAM`、`level = 0.0 dBm`。
- Internal baseband characteristics：aliasing filter 具 amplitude、group delay、sin(x)/x correction；bandwidth rolloff to `–0.1 dB` 為 `250 MHz nominal`。

I/Q compensation settings：

| 項目 | Setting range | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| Carrier leakage | `–10 % to +10 %` | `0.01 %` |
| I/Q imbalance | `–1 dB to +1 dB` | `0.01 dB` |
| Quadrature offset | `–10° to +10°` | `0.01°` |

R&S SMCV100B › Signal performance for digital standards and modulation systems
3GPP FDD with `R&S®SMCVB-K242` option：EVM `1 DPCH`、RMS、frequency `1800 MHz to 2200 MHz` 為 `< 0.8%`、`0.3% measured`；ACLR test model 1、`64 DPCH`、frequency `1800 MHz to 2200 MHz`、average channel power `≤ 0 dBm`、optimization mode fast、temperature `+18 °C to +33 °C` 時，`5 MHz offset` 為 `< –63 dBc`、`–65 dBc typical`，`10 MHz offset` 為 `< –67 dBc`、`–69 dBc typical`。

Custom digital modulation with `R&S®SMCVB-K199` option：2FSK/4FSK deviation error 在 symbol rate up to `2 MHz` 為 `0.4% measured`，up to `10 MHz` 為 `1.2% measured`；MSK phase error bit rate up to `10 MHz` 為 `0.3° measured`；EVM symbol rate up to `5 MHz` 為 `0.5% RMS measured`，up to `20 MHz` 為 `2.0% RMS measured`。

- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。

R&S FSWX › 共通規格條件
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature storage 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。

- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

EVM › 與既有測試脈絡的關係
- [[FWA CPE]] 與 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 中的戶外高階 mmWave ODU DVT 項目列出 FR2 EVM，但來源未提供 EVM limit、測試配置或標準章節。
- [[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] 保存 base station Tx / Rx / OTA tests 檔名，但附件未擷取，因此不能補充 EVM 測項。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 補入的是 NR-FR1 SA UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH 脈絡，不等同 FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、base station 或 production-line EVM limits。

EVM › unresolved
- EVM 的完整公式、filtering、averaging、reference waveform 產生方式與 test equipment uncertainty 未由 [[WIC Glossary]] 提供。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只摘錄 selected 3GPP conformance limits；完整 tables 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]]。
- [[FWA CPE]] 中 FR2 EVM 的標準依據與測試條件未標示。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › 2T4R example
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 來源以 2T4R 示意圖標出 antenna 0–3、resource ID #1 / #2 與 slot pattern，但未提供完整 numerology、bandwidth、SRS resource configuration 或 expected limits。

[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 補充 2T4R 的一般定義：2 個 SRS resources，每個含 2 個 SRS ports，分別在不同 OFDM symbols 中對應不同 physical UE antenna pairs。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › unresolved
- [[CMX500_Callbox]] 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 未標示正式日期、文件版本、作者、適用 CMX software release 或 receiver pre-adder configuration command。
- 來源中的 draw.io 圖與 Figure 1–5 轉檔不完整，需回原 PDF / 圖檔確認。
- 需要正式 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 原文來驗證 Section 6.2.1.2 的 configuration list、guard period 與 xTyR 定義。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › Guard period 與 1T4R 限制
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，Tx switching transient time 需要兩個 SRS transmissions 之間的 minimum guard period：

| SCS | Guard period |
|---:|---:|
| 15 kHz | 1 symbol |
| 30 kHz | 1 symbol |
| 60 kHz | 2 symbols |
| 120 kHz | 2 symbols |

來源註明：UE 在 guard period 期間不傳送任何其他 signal。

來源並指出：由於一個 slot 最多可為 UE configure 6 symbols，1T4R antenna switching 因 guard period 資源不足，無法在一個 slot 內達成。此處是 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 對 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] antenna switching timing / resource 的說法；尚未由正式 3GPP 原文頁驗證。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS antenna switching 技術背景
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]：

- [[SRS antenna switching]] 讓 [[UE]] 可以將 SRS transmissions route 到其他可用 antenna ports。
- 若 UE 支援此 feature，[[gNB]] 可要求 UE 在不同 symbols across all downlink receive antennas 傳送 SRS，以 better calibrate [[MIMO]] channel 並 improve downlink SNR。
- 在 [[MIMO]] setup 中，UE 可能有比某個 physical signal 的 logical ports 更多的 physical antennas；UE 因此需要把 logical ports mapping 到可用 physical antennas 的 subset。
- UE 可能在不同 [[OFDM symbol]] 中以不同 physical antennas 傳送，因此需要隨時間切換 logical-to-physical port mapping。
- 來源稱 3GPP Release 15 的一個 use case 是 different SRS resources 的 SRS logical ports 在不同 OFDM symbols 中 transmission，以便從 UE 所有 physical transmit antennas 進行 channel sounding。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Abbreviations
來源列出縮寫：

- 5G NR：5G New Radio。
- ACLR：Adjacent channel leakage power ratio。
- CA：Carrier aggregation。
- DUT：Device under test。
- EVM：Error vector magnitude。
- FDD：Frequency division duplex。
- FR1：Frequency range 1。
- MIMO：Multiple input multiple output。
- OBUE：Operating band unwanted emissions。
- OBW：Occupied bandwidth。
- OTA：Over the air。
- PDSCH：Physical downlink shared channel。
- Prat：Rated output power。
- RB：Resource block。
- RBW：Resolution bandwidth。
- RF：Radio frequency。
- RIB：Radiated interface boundary。
- RS：Reference signal。
- SCS：Subcarrier spacing。
- SSB：Synchronization signal block。
- TAB：Transceiver array boundary。
- TAE：Time alignment error。
- TDD：Time division duplex。
- TM：Test model。
- VSWR：Voltage standing wave ratio。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.2 Frequency error
- 定義為 actual NR BS transmit frequency 與 assigned frequency 的差值讀值。
- Frequency error requirements：
  - Wide Area BS：±(0.05 ppm + 12 Hz)。
  - Medium Range BS：±(0.1 ppm + 12 Hz)。
  - Local Area BS：±(0.1 ppm + 12 Hz)。
- 此量測中，FSW 必須透過 external reference 與 high precision time reference 同步。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.4 Time alignment error（TAE）
- TAE 定義為任兩個 NR signals 之間最大的 timing difference。
- Requirement 適用於 Tx diversity、MIMO transmission、carrier aggregation 及其組合的 frame timing。

TAE limits：

- MIMO / Tx diversity at each carrier frequency：90 ns。
- Intra-band CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：285 ns。
- Intra-band non-contiguous CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：3.025 μs。
- Inter-band CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：3.025 μs。

測試 setup：

- DUT 通常以 NR-FR1-TM1.1 搭配 MIMO transmission 或 carrier aggregation transmitting。
- 待量測 antennas 透過一個或多個 cascaded hybrid couplers 連接。
- FSW 透過 attenuator 連接。
- RF cables 應具有相同 electrical length。
- 最多可 parallel 量測 4 antennas。
- 量測基於個別 antennas 的 reference signal DM-RS。
- PDSCHs 會被忽略。
- 量測永遠相對於一個 reference antenna。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.4 Transmit ON/OFF power
- Transmit OFF power requirements 僅適用於 NR BS 的 TDD operation。
- Transmitter OFF power 定義為 transmitter OFF period 期間，使用 bandwidth 等於 BS transmission bandwidth configuration（BWconfig）且 centered on assigned channel frequency 的 square filter，於 70/N μs 內量測的 mean power。
- N = SCS/15，其中 SCS 為 kHz 單位。
- Transmitter OFF power limit：f ≤ 3.0 GHz 為 -83.0 dBm/MHz；3.0 GHz < f ≤ 6.0 GHz 為 -82.5 dBm/MHz。
- 測試需要 RF limiter 限制 transmitter ON periods 期間 analyzer 接收的 power，使 OFF periods 量測可使用 full dynamic range。
- 可額外使用 attenuator 吸收 limiter reflected power，以最佳化 VSWR。

### Short answer
EVM means Error Vector Magnitude, and in 5G NR test context it is the measured difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [2].  
For base-station modulation quality, EVM is the difference between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, where that difference is called the error vector [10].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on EVM
| Decision area | What the EVM understanding controls | Product / test context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE FR1 SA pre-conformance setup | The EVM PUCCH/PUSCH test case requires choosing the Test ID, RB allocation, modulation scheme, max-power and min-power measurement points, and verifying that DUT EVM is within the specified range [1]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1 on CMX workflow [1]. | [1] |
| UE FR1 EVM limit selection | The applicable average EVM limit depends on modulation, with listed limits for Pi/2-BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM, plus test tolerance rules [3]. | 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance EVM limits [3]. | [3] |
| UE min-power / 256QAM planning | Minimum-power interpretation matters because 256QAM Test IDs use target power Pmin + 10 dB, and Pmin depends on channel bandwidth [55]. | 3GPP TS 38.521-1 minimum-power context summarized in EVM page [55]. | [55] |
| CMX500 NR FR1 uplink TX option planning | R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC measurement [24]. | R&S CMX500 NR FR1 measurements [24]. | [24] |

| OTA base-station metric selection | OTA modulation quality is classified as EVM and directional [31]. | 5G NR OTA base-station transmitter tests [31]. | [31] |

- Multipath wideband phase coherent receivers 可使用 independent receivers 同時進行 signal analysis 與 spectrum analysis。
- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。
- 可同時量測 antenna 的 H 或 V polarizations、device input 與 output，並直接比較 ports 之間的 amplitude、frequency、phase。
- Image free I/Q and vector signal analysis 使用 preselected capture and analysis，避免 unwanted signals 干擾量測。
- Operating system：Linux based operating system，目標為 high security 與 long-term support。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。
